title: Manyhands JSON v1 primary local commits data
description: The data of a repo sync envelope, or of the envelope of an operation resume that took the operation of one up, refused with primary_has_local_commits: in a pull-request repository repo sync only fetches and fast-forwards the primary branch, and never merges or pushes it, and the local primary has commits the remote does not have. Nothing was published and every effect is not_requested. The operation is ended and the repository is not held, and no recovery action is offered: moving the commits to a branch of their own is Git work outside Manyhands. Sending the same request again answers the same, from its record.

type.description: The one value that tells this data apart.

local_commits.description: The local primary's commits that the remote does not have, newest first: at most 20. Empty when the push endpoint is ahead of what was fetched.

oid.description: The commit, in full: 40 hexadecimal characters.

summary.description: The first line of the commit's message. It is the author's text: a consumer escapes it as a field.

complete.description: Whether local_commits lists every such commit. False when there are more than it lists.
